newsitem.title: UK: Italian enquiry noted in cotton market.
newsitem.headline: Italian enquiry noted in cotton market.

text.p: Strengthening New York futures prompted several traders to revise their offering rates for raw cotton marginally up, industry sources said on Friday.
But there was no fundamental change in sentiment and prices for upland cottons remained rangebound, they said.
Italian buyers injected a little fresh interest into the market, seeking West African new crop styles for an unknown delivery date, one source said.
The rest of Europe had an extremely quiet day with limited hand-to-mouth buying offering traders no surprises.
